name: prolifik
description: Clip long videos into captioned shorts, make branded short-form videos and schedule them to TikTok, Instagram, YouTube and X from your Prolifik account.

interface.longDescription:
Prolifik turns long videos and brand websites into short-form social content. Connect your Prolifik account and ask for what you need in chat.

What you can do:
- Clip a YouTube video, a Twitch or Kick stream, or an uploaded file into captioned vertical clips, and follow the job until the clips are ready.
- Generate a batch of branded videos for one of your brands in Prolifik's formats, such as Image Carousel, Text Story, Meme Reaction, Clip Montage, Caption Meme and Video Hook & Demo.
- Add a web page as a content source so new videos stay grounded in what it says.
- Clone a TikTok or Instagram post into variations in your brand's voice, and translate the ones that work.
- Create AI Studio images and videos with the models available on your account.
- Publish or schedule finished videos and clips to the TikTok, Instagram, YouTube and X accounts connected to your brand, and check how each post went.
- Check your usage: clip minutes, renders and videos left this month.

You sign in with your existing Prolifik account. Anything that posts publicly, deletes or overwrites is marked so your assistant asks before running it.
defaultPrompt: Clip this YouTube video into 3 vertical shorts with captions
Show my Prolifik usage for this month
Make 2 Text Story videos for my brand

positive.description: Read the account's brands and latest clips
positive.prompt: List my Prolifik brands and show the latest clip job with its clips.
positive.expected_behavior: Shows the "3betmedia" brand and the most recent completed clip job with its two clips (titles, durations, links).

positive.prompt: How much of my Prolifik plan have I used this month?
positive.expected_behavior: Reports renders used and remaining, videos kept, and clip minutes left for the billing period on the Pro plan.

positive.prompt: Clip this YouTube video into 2 vertical shorts with captions: https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=p7HKvqRI_Bo
positive.expected_behavior: Queues a Clipper job, reports progress, and when it finishes (about 2 to 4 minutes) returns two captioned vertical clips.

positive.prompt: Make 2 Text Story videos for my 3betmedia brand, then show me the scripts.
positive.expected_behavior: Queues a 2-piece Text Story job for the brand and, once rendered (about 1 minute), shows each piece's script and video link.

positive.prompt: Add https://getprolifik.com/docs/mcp as a content source for my brand and tell me what it is about.
positive.expected_behavior: Creates the source, waits for the analysis, and summarizes the page's key points.

negative.description: Unrelated request: nothing to do with video, clips or the user's Prolifik account.
negative.prompt: What's the weather in Vilnius tomorrow?

negative.description: General coding help: no Prolifik data or action is involved.
negative.prompt: Write a Python function that sorts a list of numbers.

negative.description: Billing change: the plugin has no billing or purchase tools; plans and credits are bought only in the Prolifik dashboard.
negative.prompt: Upgrade my Prolifik subscription to Enterprise and buy 3,000 credits.
